subject: Evaluation playlist: kickoff, roles, gates

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation playlist: kickoff, roles, gates

Hi Samantha / Carlos —

Thanks again for the quick discovery earlier. I wanted to capture the agreed-upon scope and propose a tight evaluation playlist so we can get to a meaningful readout in three weeks. High level: light integration with your inference path, end-to-end run of 3 representative flows, quantitative checks (latency/cost/accuracy), and a customer-facing final readout.

Proposed milestones (attached: POC-schedule-v1.xlsx):
- Kickoff call (10/11): align owners, access, and sample data
- Week 1 (10/11–10/17): infra validation + baseline perf (Karthik lead)
- Week 2 (10/18–10/24): feature/quality checks, prompts & failure-mode review (Jordan/Marissa)
- Week 3 (10/25–10/29): final run, cost comparison, and readout prep
- Final readout (week of 11/1): 30–45 minute presentation + scorecard

Acceptance gates (draft):
1) Latency: p95 <= 450ms on our dev traffic profile (config: medium GPU, batching disabled)
2) Quality: at least 85% agreement with your human labels on the 200-sample set
3) Stability: no more than 3% error rate under sustained throughput for 15 minutes
4) Deliverables: sample dataset + test prompt set delivered by EOD 10/10; access details (API keys, VPC peering notes) by kickoff

Owners (proposed):
- Jordan Blake (Redwood) — project lead, readout ownership
- Karthik Iyer (Redwood) — technical integration lead; infra validation
- Marissa Cole (Redwood CS) — cadence, success metrics, readout slides
- Samantha Lopez (Tethys) — product owner; provides acceptance criteria and sample data
- Carlos Medina (Tethys) — infra lead; provides access and network details

Next steps
1) Samantha to confirm sample dataset availability and any adjustments to acceptance criteria by 10/06
2) Redwood to share updated schedule and checklist (attached) by 10/07
3) Kickoff call invite for 10/11 (proposed 10:00am PT)

Attaching: POC-schedule-v1.xlsx (timeline + owners)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

--
Jordan Blake

jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks Jordan — this is a great start and mirrors what we discussed. A couple quick clarifications from Tethys: 

- Latency target: our goal is p95 <= 350ms for interactive flows; is 450ms only for the medium-GPU baseline you suggested? If the RB can hit 350ms on a medium config that would be ideal.
- Data residency: we need the test runs to stay in US-East (we'll provide creds for that region)
- Security: we will need SOC2 evidence and confirmation on retention policies before the final readout (Carlos will coordinate)

We can deliver the 200-sample labeled set by 10/10 and Carlos will provide the network contact for VPC peering. Kickoff on 10/11 at 10:00am PT works for us. Please include a link for the shared doc and the meeting invite.

Also, can you confirm whether the performance runs will be measured from your hosted endpoint or from our dedicated pool? That will change the cost comparison section.

Onwards —
Samantha
